page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.hfg7 family. It is equipped with 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8369HB. This instance features a 1:1 ratio of physical cores to vCPUs, meaning hyperthreading is disabled with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources for demanding workloads.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated physical cores, making it suitable for workloads that require predictable CPU performance without the latency jitter associated with hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, intensive batch processing, financial modeling, and compute-heavy application servers.
